message:
Command `cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"description.txt","function":"<global>","line":1,"var":"JPEG component subsampling ratios","code":"stb_image does not reject fractional JPEG component subsampling ratios.","note":"The vulnerability hypothesis is that crafted JPEG metadata can drive unsupported resampling ratios into the decoder."},
  {"step":2,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3158,"var":"z->img_comp[i].h / z->img_comp[i].v","code":"z->img_comp[i].h = (q >> 4); ... z->img_comp[i].v = q & 15;","note":"The JPEG SOF header supplies per-component horizontal and vertical sampling factors."},
  {"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__process_frame_header","line":3180,"var":"z->img_comp[i].w2 / z->img_comp[i].h2","code":"z->img_comp[i].raw_data = stbi__malloc_mad2(z->img_comp[i].w2, z->img_comp[i].h2, 15);","note":"The decoder allocates component buffers based on the declared sampling factors, so malformed ratios propagate into later resampling state."},
  {"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3758,"var":"r->hs","code":"r->hs = z->img_h_max / z->img_comp[k].h;","note":"During JPEG load, the code derives the horizontal upsampling ratio from the header-controlled sampling factors."},
  {"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3759,"var":"r->vs","code":"r->vs = z->img_v_max / z->img_comp[k].v;","note":"The vertical upsampling ratio is derived the same way and can become a non-1/2 value for crafted component layouts."},
  {"step":6,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3766,"var":"r->resample","code":"if      (r->hs == 1 && r->vs == 1) ... else if ... else r->resample = stbi__resample_row_generic;","note":"Before the fix, unsupported ratios fell through to the generic resampler instead of being rejected."},
  {"step":7,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"stbi__resample_row_generic","line":3502,"var":"out[i*hs+j]","code":"for (i=0; i < w; ++i) for (j=0; j < hs; ++j) out[i*hs+j] = in_near[i];","note":"The generic resampler assumes integer expansion factors and writes using hs as a repeat count, which is unsafe for fractional JPEG subsampling ratios."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
PY` executed with exit code 0.
